published_ranges._hardness: 95A (store/listing name only; no Shore value printed in TDS)
published_ranges._notes: Official TDS (wiki.kingroon.com, file name kingroon_tpu_95a_technical_data_sheet_v1.0.pdf, update 2025/12/1) is titled 'TPU 90A' throughout its text and prints no Shore value and no 95A; it is the only TPU TDS Kingroon publishes, so hardness/TDS match remains UNCONFIRMED. Retraction speed is printed truncated in the source itself ('10- 30mm/'), so it is left out. TDS also: printer heatbed drying 90C 16h; nozzle sizes 0.4/0.6/0.8; plates Smooth/Textured PEI with glue; fan on; HDT/Vicat/Tg N/A, melting 180C. Retraction/print-speed/chamber label mapping inferred from the flattened PDF layout (value order matches the other Kingroon V1.0 TDS sheets: retraction length, retraction speed, chamber temp, overhang, bridging ... printing speed). kingroon.com TPU page names 'Kingroon TPU 95A' but publishes no settings; recommends Cool/High Temp/Textured PEI plate, not Engineering Plate. Diameter tolerance +/-0.03 appears only on the third-party-seller Amazon listing. Earlier entry: TDS file is named kingroon_tpu_95a but its title and text say 'TPU 90A'; Kingroon's stores only sell 95A solids and 85A rainbow TPU, so this TDS is attached to the 95A line with the hardness discrepancy flagged. TDS: drying alternative printer heatbed 90 C 16 h; Smooth / Textured PEI with glue; fan on; melting 180 C; retraction speed printed truncated as '10-30mm/' so not recorded; ABS spool rated 90 C. Verification 2026-11-01: fields and plate/chamber/fan/retraction ranges confirmed against the TDS PDF; kingroon.com / kingroon3d.com product pages returned HTTP 429, so page-derived notes and conflicts were not re-checked.
